sentence: This project records and labels real traffic from a research network and shares the labeled datasets with researchers working on security.
This project builds computational tools and datasets to find where plant genes start being read and how that shapes the proteins they make.
This project studies how differences in gene expression shape why closely related marine annelid species develop in different ways.
This project studies how protein complexes start to repair damaged DNA, using yeast and detailed views of their structures.
This project builds a learning platform that helps people who are not computer experts recognize and handle dark patterns.
This project studies how intelligent reflecting surfaces can make wireless communication among many Internet of Things devices more secure and energy efficient.
This project builds mathematical models of how infectious diseases spread in queues and how queues can reveal sensitive information in security systems.
This project finds and describes species of microscopic nematodes in lakes, streams and wet meadows and studies where they live.
This project studies a surface covered in nanoscale pillars that damages bacteria on contact without antibiotics, for use on implantable medical devices.
This project builds a unified framework for neural operators, a type of machine learning model, that makes surrogate models of fluid flows more trustworthy.
This project studies how corals grow their crystal skeletons and which factors affect how fast the crystals form.
This project studies how to control decoherence in hybrid systems that link diamond spin qubits with magnons.
This project develops a method that uses nanoprojectiles to map how molecules are organized in thin films at a scale approaching five nanometers.
